name: Little Hoarder
detailed_description:
Betrayed and shipwrecked, Fred finds himself marooned on a mysterious island after a devastating betrayal by his wife.

STAKE YOUR CLAIM The wilderness is wild, but it can be yours. Build a new life from the ground up, piece by piece. Construct a sturdy shelter to survive the night, lay down fences that cleverly connect to protect your farm, and furnish your home with handmade workbenches and storage chests. This untamed land is your canvas.

LIVE OFF THE LAND Your survival depends on what you can gather. Chop wood, mine for useful ores, and hunt for rare gems. Till the soil with a handmade hoe, plant seeds, and tend to your crops. Turn the island’s endless bounty into the tools, food, and resources you need to thrive.

EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN This island holds more than just trees and stone. What secrets lie hidden in the dark caves and forgotten corners of the map? As the sun sets and the shadows lengthen, be wary—you are not the only inhabitant. Craft a torch to light your way and a sword to defend what's yours from the creatures that lurk in the darkness.

Everything you build and every resource you spend is saved automatically. But the biggest question remains: Why are you here? And what is the purpose of this bizarre, regenerative island? The answers are waiting to be unearthed.

Features:

  • Shape Your World: A simple, piece-by-piece building system lets you create and customize your own home and farm.

  • Endless Resources: Gather from an island where forests regrow and minerals return, ensuring you'll never run out of materials for your next big project.

  • From Seed to Harvest: Develop a farm to grow essential food and valuable crops.

  • Craft for Survival: Create everything you need to prosper, from essential tools and weapons to furniture for your home.

  • Face the Darkness: Explore dangerous caves and defend your base from creatures when the sun goes down.

  • Uncover a Mystery: Discover the secrets of the island and the reason you're here in a world that saves your every accomplishment.

short_description: Betrayed and shipwrecked, Fred awakens on a mysterious island that regenerates everything he collects. Grief turns to obsession as he hoards endlessly. Explore, gather, and uncover the secrets of the island—and the truth behind your exile.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen or newer) AMD equivalent (e.g., AMD FX-4100 or better)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better OpenGL 3.3+ or DirectX 10+ support required
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card, onboard audio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04+ / Any modern 64-bit Linux distro
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz dual-core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan compatible GPU with at least 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card, onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Runs well on Steam Deck and low-end systems. Game is CPU-light and GPU-friendly.
